overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: removing the public from the chamber and barring them from City Hall during an executive session was permitted, and the Council did not deliberate outside a posted meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Council improperly removed members of the public from the meeting room before an executive session held December 4, 2023.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by requiring members of the public to leave the Council chamber and restricting their attendance at the executive session meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Council improperly denied the public entry to City Hall after the open session, when police escorted attendees out and barred re-entry.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we do not find a violation here when members of the public were removed and prohibited from entering City Hall.

allegations.summary: One complainant alleged Council members deliberated after the meeting ended, pointing to a member leaving at 8:20 P.M. while the Council remained inside for another hour.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Council did not deliberate outside of a properly posted meeting.
